displayName: Draft personalised rejection emails from your pipeline
summary: Close out pipeline candidates with a personalised note for each one.

useCases.title: Draft personalised rejection emails from your pipeline
useCases.message: Help me close out candidates in my pipeline. Ask me which role or stage to focus on. If you don't already know which ATS I use, ask. Then pull the candidates who need a rejection from my ATS, and draft a short personalised email for each one. Ask me to review before anything gets sent.
